This document exercises a non-default (numeric/Vancouver-style) CSL style —
IEEE — to verify that pandoc-cite does not interfere with citeproc's normal
style handling. Unlike `integration.qmd` (which uses the default author-date
style), citations here should render as bracketed numeric markers like
`[1]`, `[2]`, `[3]`, not author names.

Nature paper on CRISPR [@doi:10.1038/nature12373].

Transformer architecture paper [@arxiv:1706.03762].

Quarto filters documentation [@url:https://quarto.org/docs/extensions/filters.html].
